title: Feature-montage: fast-paced showcase of jumps, dodges, revive, and speed

clips.why: Opens on the high-energy barrier jump and GREAT JUMP! banner
Quick cut to lane-switching dodge and NICE DODGE! callout
Tightened stretch showing speed ramping up toward barriers
Demonstrates obstacle collision and Free Revive recovery
Fast highway run collecting coins as speed climbs
Tight obstacle dodging at speed 76 near 235m
Final high-speed crash at 246m and Game Over explosion
Call to action end card with PLAY NOW tap
